<!-- See CONTRIBUTING.md. Keep the checks that apply. -->

- [ ] `dotnet build -c Release` and `dotnet test -c Release --filter "Category!=Hardware"` pass
- [ ] A new or changed tweak or check has EN and DE explanation pages with sources I opened, and an impact the evidence carries
- [ ] Nothing in the tests touches the real PC (registry sandbox and fakes only)
- [ ] User-visible changes are in CHANGELOG.md, and README or docs/ are updated where they describe them
- [ ] UI changes were checked in Light and Dark, English and German
